youtube_title: 0 Percent Interest Loan, Just Pay the Fee First? Scam of the Week #13 #Shorts
youtube_description:
SCAM OF THE WEEK #13. An ad promises a zero-interest loan in 5 minutes, but first you must pay a processing fee. Pay it or check first?
Check first. Under RBI's Digital Lending Directions 2025, a regulated lender gives you a Key Fact Statement with the APR (the full yearly cost) before the loan, and the money goes straight into your own bank account. RBI's website lists the digital lending apps of regulated lenders. Scammed? Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
Source: RBI (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025. Education only, not financial advice.

Scam of the Week #13 🚨 'Zero percent interest, 5 minute mein loan, bas pehle processing fee bhejo.'
Fee gayi, loan kabhi nahi aata. Asli lender loan se pehle Key Fact Statement deta hai (APR = saal ka poora kharcha) aur paisa seedha tumhare bank account mein.
App check karo RBI ki website pe digital lending apps ki list mein. Phas gaye? 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in
